title: Cmd-D from a browser tab, the New Tab page or an agent chat opens the New Tab page in the new pane, and its Open Tabs row moves that tab there; a terminal's Cmd-D keeps the terminal (cx-jfo7)
preconditions: a fresh launch: one window, one workspace, one terminal tab with keyboard focus

steps.note: the scenario of scripts/cmux-next/split-new-tab-page-e2e.py (kept), in one workspace: the script opens a fresh workspace per leg, a person's Cmd-N now opens a New Tab page workspace, and a script caller's workspace is not shown
Split Right on a terminal: the new pane holds a terminal (resolved terminal), not the New Tab page
New Browser Tab in the new terminal's pane; the browser tab takes the focus
the New Tab page (an agent page) opens in the new pane and its field takes the keyboard; on b945566eb87 (cx-jfo7's parent) the split of a browser tab opened a terminal, so the wait times out

expect.noReceiptReason: a click on the page's first Open Tabs row; the moved tab and the closed page are its result

steps.note: the picked tab moves into the page's pane in the page's place and the page closes, so the focus leaves the agent page; whichever workspace tab row 0 is, every pane then holds what it held before the split plus the moved tab
Cmd-T opens the New Tab page in the focused pane
the New Tab page's own split opens another New Tab page in the new pane
New Agent Chat (the mock agent): the chat opens in the workspace's chat dock and takes the focus
the chat's split opens the New Tab page in the dock's strip (the dock never splits)

invariants: focus at split-terminal-done resolves to a terminal in the new pane
focus at page-from-browser, page-from-page and page-from-chat resolves to an agentPage in a pane other than the one the split started from (the chat's: a tab of the dock's strip)
at picked the New Tab page is gone from topology and every pane holds at least one tab: the pick moved a tab, it did not copy or drop one
every mutation has one receipt or one typed error (I1)
ids stay stable unless the step created or closed them (I2)
teardown: quit the tagged app the run started
verify its debug socket is gone
untested: the Open Tabs rows' titles (debug.new_tab field open_tabs) and which tab the script's title match picks: no facet reads the page's rows, so the case picks row 0
a workspace per leg as in the script: each leg here starts from the panes the earlier legs left
the script's window capture (debug.window_snapshot); captures are the media tours' job
